snippet.title: Project 14 | One-on-One With the Creators | Behind the Game
snippet.description:
Who's behind Project 14? And how did a small vacation project turn into a psychological puzzle game full of bizarre tests, hidden secrets and dark humour?

In this video, we step away from the gameplay and sit down for a relaxed conversation about the people, ideas and experiences behind Project 14.

We talk about how the game started, why it's called Project 14 and the inspiration behind its unusual puzzles and mechanics.

🎮 **Wishlist Project 14 on Steam:**
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391910/Project_14/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391910/Project_14/)

**About Project 14**

Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, unconventional challenges, dark humour and unexpected twists.

Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and discover how your choices influence the experience. Following the rules isn't always the best idea.

Developed by Nobody's Production
Published by Atomic Pigeon Interactive
